newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-Apasco started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Apasco started as buy.

text.p: Smith Barney has initiated coverage of Mexican cement manufacturer Apasco with a buy recommendation, the company told Reuters on Friday.

Smith Barney's 12-month price target for Apasco ADRs was $50, an upside potential of 51 percent, based on projected EBITDA growth of 21 percent from 1997 to 1998, and growth in the company's FV/EBITDA multiple from 9.4 times to 10.9 times.

"We expect multiple expansion based on historical levels. Possible catalysts include higher cement prices and volumes in the second quarter, the approval of a more than 200 percent real increase in the cash dividend and the creation of 350 million peso ($44 million) reserve for share buybacks," analyst Carmen Slade wrote in a report.
Apasco ADRs were not traded today, and closed at 34 on March 31.
In Mexico City, Apasco shares were up 50 centavos at 53.30 pesos.
